svg.title: Taiyo Kami Bloodright — Covenant of the Sun. Idea 1.
svg.desc: Ten skills, four purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Dawnheart forks into Crown of Cinders then Solar Cataclysm, or Emberwake then Eternal Noon. Sunward Oath forks into Golden Mantle then Sovereign Sun, or Ashen Verdict then Dying Light. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Scorch-classified Taiyo Kami jutsu.

g.text: Idea 1 · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Taiyo Kami jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Both Ignition damage buffs + Inferno exposure
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · DDG: Decrease Damage Given
Level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Ignition · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Idea 1 assumes a potency-only classification lookup. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · Four Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
